company.name: Heron Data
company.shortDescription: Heron Data utilizes AI to automate document intake, extraction, and enrichment in the lending, equipment finance, and insurance industries.
company.description: Heron Data provides infrastructure that enables financial institutions and fintech companies to analyze business bank transactions and extract structured insights. The company focuses on automating underwriting and financial analysis by transforming raw transaction data into standardized, machine-readable formats. Its software integrates with various data sources to classify, enrich, and label transaction streams, helping teams make faster and more informed credit decisions. Heron Data serves lenders, neobanks, and other financial platforms that require scalable and accurate transaction data analysis. The platform also offers tools for understanding cash flow, detecting financial risk, and tracking business health over time. Through these capabilities, Heron Data helps financial teams streamline operations and reduce manual review workloads.
